The '''''Liberator''-class starfighter''', known by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as the '''Talon fighter''', was a model of [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to and during the [[Great Galactic War]].

One of the ship's variants was the '''''Striker''-class''', mostly used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Satele Shan]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Liberator''-class starfighter served as the primary defense against the Mk VI and Mk VII Imperial interceptors employed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the Great Galactic War and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

Like other starfighters and smaller transport designs of the era, excluding a few notable exceptions like the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]], the [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor]], the [[BT-7 Thunderclap]] assault ship, and the [[X-70B Phantom-class prototype|X-70B ''Phantom''-class prototype]] transport, the ''Liberator''-class did not have hyperdrive engines.
This forced their pilots to rely on larger ships, such as the [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] and [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] to carry them to their destination.

Swivel-mounted wings allow the ''Liberator'' to be stored aboard larger vessels with impressive efficiency, often catching enemy forces by surprise when multiple squadrons are deployed from a single starship.<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The ''Liberator''-class could remain in active deployment for up to 37 standard hours.<ref name=":0" />

A different model of the fighter, known as the ''Striker''-class, had additional room for an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] storage.<ref name="Lego">{{LEGOCite|num=9497|name=Republic Striker Starfighter }}</ref> 

===Role===
Fast, agile, and versatile, the ''Liberator''-class starfighter is a true multi-role craft, capable of functioning as an escort, interceptor, or precision strike platform. It can also perform attack runs against enemy capital ships or space stations when bombers are unavailable.<ref name=":0" />

==History==
These starfighters were used to escort a diplomatic convoy of [[Republic transport ship]]s to investigate unidentified starships that had invaded the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|obliterated]] by the forces of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]]. Several fighters were also used to reclaim Alderaan following the battle of the same name.

These fighters later served as the primary starfighters during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mk. VI Imperial interceptors]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial Navy]]. They were loaded onto the Republic's [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] and [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruisers]].

The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Satele Shan]] was known to use the ''Striker''-class variant on missions for the Republic.<ref name="Lego" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Striker'' variant of the ''Liberator''-class starfighter appears in the [[2012]] [[LEGO Star Wars]] set [[W:c:lego:9497 Republic Striker Starfighter|9497 Republic Striker Starfighter]].
